entities.summary: Self-Strengthening Movement, a transformative movement in China (1839–1912). Emerged from Taiping Rebellion and Siku Quanshu — largest collection of books in Chinese history — compiled. Catalyzed Treaty of Nanjing — China cedes Hong Kong and opens treaty ports and Taiping Rebellion — deadliest civil war in history with up to 30 million deaths.
